question: The downstream speed of a boat is 25 km/hr and the speed of stream is 3 km/hr. What will be the total time taken by the boat to cover 100 km downstream and 57 km upstream?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Upstream Speed = Downstream Speed − 2 × Stream Speed = 25 − (2 × 3) = 19 km/hr

Downstream Time = 100 ÷ 25 = 4 hours

Upstream Time = 57 ÷ 19 = 3 hours

Total Time = 4 + 3 = 7 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 7 hours.**
